subject: Whistic + Vendr profile consolidation for Acme Health — merge & retirement plan
messages:
From: Janelle Ortiz <jortiz@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating our vendor profiles (Whistic + Vendr)

Hi Stephanie —

Quick note from Acme Health's security team: we recently discovered two active profiles for Redwood: one in Whistic and one in Vendr. Our procurement/infosec people would like a single canonical profile for attestation and annual refreshes.

Can Redwood consolidate the two (keep the more recent Vendr answers as the source of truth) and retire the older Whistic profile? We need the consolidated CAIQ/SIG-backed answers and an evidence manifest (what files map to which questions) so we can attach it to our vendor intake record.

Attachments: acme_whistic_profile_link.txt (link), SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (summary stub)

Would you be able to confirm a timeline and who on your side will own this? Our deadline for the procurement window is Nov 19.

Thanks,
Janelle Ortiz
Vendor Risk Lead
Acme Health
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Janelle Ortiz <jortiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our vendor profiles (Whistic + Vendr)

Thanks for the heads up, Janelle — we can do that. I'm putting Marcus (security ops) and Priyom (portal integrations) on this thread to coordinate the merge and evidence manifest.

Planned approach (high level):
- Inventory both profiles (Whistic + Vendr) and export CAIQ/SIG JSON/CSV.
- Canonicalization: pick Vendr as source of truth and map any Whistic-only evidence to Vendr question IDs.
- Produce an evidence manifest (CSV) that lists question_id, answer, evidence_filename, evidence_source, last_modified.
- Deprecate the Whistic profile after a 48-hour overlap window and add a redirect link for sharing.

Action items:
- Marcus: can you run a quick gap diff between Vendr profile and the Whistic export and flag high-risk mismatches?
- Priyom: can you pull the evidence bundle from Vendr and produce the manifest format Janelle requested?
- Janelle: can you confirm access to the Whistic profile link we were sent (we only have a read-only URL in the txt)?

Timeline: we'll aim for a 10 business day turnaround; that lands before your Nov 19 window if nothing blocks us. I'll update you by EOD Wednesday with the inventory summary.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our vendor profiles (Whistic + Vendr)

Stephanie / Priyom — quick status update from security ops after pulling the exports this morning:

Findings (summary):
- Vendr profile (AH-6789) is more up to date for operational controls and contains the latest SOC 2 evidence.
- Whistic export has a handful (~12) of questions with richer narrative around third-party data processors that are not present in Vendr. None are blocking but a few could be material for Acme's legal review.
- We have three evidence items currently only in Whistic: third_party_agreements_q27.pdf, sso_saml_config_snapshot.txt, and data_retention_table.xlsx.

Proposed next steps:
1) Priyom to ingest Whistic-only evidence into our secure evidence bucket and add mappings to the manifest. Evidence will be stored as read-only objects with retention metadata.
2) I will produce a short risk memo highlighting the 12 narrative gaps and label any items that require legal sign-off.
3) Stephanie, once you confirm we should proceed, we'll schedule the 48-hour overlap and retire the Whistic profile.

Attachments: vendor-evidence-manifest.csv (draft)

Marcus Lin
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Janelle Ortiz <jortiz@acmehealth.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our vendor profiles (Whistic + Vendr)

Hi Janelle — we completed the evidence ingest and produced the manifest. Summary below and links to artifacts:

What we did:
- Ingested Whistic-only evidence into our S3 evidence-store (read-only bucket, lifecycle tag: retention=3y).
- Normalized question IDs between Vendr (ah-6789) and Whistic export and wrote the mapping rules.
- Generated vendor-evidence-manifest.csv that includes question_id, answer, evidence_filename, evidence_source (Whistic/Vendr), and md5.
- Pushed the consolidated profile to Vendr and set a redirect from the old Whistic public link to the Vendr canonical URL.

What we attached/included:
- vendor-evidence-manifest.csv (attached) — CSV maps each evidence item to the question.
- SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (attached) — redacted summary for portal consumption.
- For legal: marcus uploaded the 12 narrative gaps memo to our internal drive and flagged items that may need signature. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/secure/acme-merge-memo

Request from Acme: please confirm that the Vendr canonical profile meets your procurement requirements. If you need the Whistic question narratives preserved inline, we can append them as narrative fragments to the Vendr answers (minor formatting).

Next steps if confirmed:
- Wait 48 hours for your team to pull artifacts and confirm.
- After confirmation, we'll retire the Whistic profile and mark it deprecated in our internal inventory.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor-evidence-manifest.csv (attachment), SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (attachment)
